scope: All 1519 noncanonical predstav-family tokens in the four post-EDIT-0015 editable Latin components.
choice: Normalize the complete family to official prědstav- forms. Correct the 55 malformed or nationally shaped predstavlj-/predstavlaj-/predstavaj- derivatives to project morphology, including prědstavja, prědstavjajut, prědstavjaje, prědstavjene, prědstavjena, prědstavjeno, prědstavjajuči, and contextual prědstavime.
motivation: The official type-1 family uses prědstaviti, prědstavjati, and prědstavjenje with broad cross-branch support. The inherited corpus mixed that family with 1519 unmarked predstav- spellings and 55 malformed or South-shaped derivatives. A single official family improves corpus-wide coherence and recognizability without altering the mathematical sense.
alternatives_rejected: Retain both predstav- and prědstav- as an unexplained reader-wide doublet.
Blindly add only the etymological vowel while preserving malformed predstavlj- morphology.
Leave the known inconsistency for a later human reviewer.
